main_measure.name: pooled slope of next-day excess return on forecast

statistic.name: slope t, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: t >= 2 with top-minus-bottom fifth > 0; reject: t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top fifth minus bottom fifth mean next-day excess return

decided_by: Slope t >= 2 and the top-minus-bottom-fifth difference is above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: Every bar with a forecast and a next-day return inside its window is a case (forecast-0 bars included); the day-clustered slope t uses residual-times-forecast deviations summed per UTC day with a G/(G-1) correction; fifths are the pooled 20th/80th forecast percentiles; the plan's minimum counts, if not reached, give 'not observable' as the workflow requires.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0001964 on the check folds against +0.0006283 on every fold
